anomalies.observed: The isolated CAN transceivers U10 and U11 have both GND1 and GND2 pins connected to the same GND net.
anomalies.expected: For an isolated CAN transceiver, the controller-side ground (GND1) and bus-side ground (GND2) should be separate ground domains; the specification describes isolated CAN buses.

evidence.quote: two isolated CAN buses (`CAN0`, `CAN1`), each driven by its own MCP2515 SPI CAN controller (`U8`, `U9`) through an isolated CAN transceiver (`U11`/companion)

anomalies.impact: The galvanic isolation of the CAN interfaces is defeated, so the CAN buses are not isolated as intended and may be exposed to ground loops and noise from the motor side.

parsed.summary: The design files contradict the intended isolated CAN architecture: U10 and U11 tie their isolated bus-side grounds (GND2) to the main GND, removing the isolation barrier.
